schema: War requires a, b (CountryRef index, optional tag) and state enum at_war|ceasefire|capitulated|puppeted|not_at_war; front_invalidated optional

mapping.state: at_war when a CWarRelation is present at both sides' CRelationStatus+0x2e8, cancel==0, byte +0x49==0, and official end_date key is omitted; other enum values not proven

live.player_visible: player ETH is second; this is the only war in the world snapshot; not a fog-hidden third-party war
